experiment: prune-graft then widen chain test (standalone, not an engine integration)

settings.seed_rule: donor-capture rerun uses the widen test's own recorded seeds; step 1 advances the family one +100 step past the widen test (20261500/20261501), step 2 one more; within a step each arm freshly initialises its run/draw RNGs; the step-2 gate representative draw uses step-2 draw seed + 999 (the widen test's protocol)
settings.freeze_rule: units whose silencing drop clears the paired-noise band upward (contributing) on the current champion's table are marked useful; their genes mutate at rate 0 and they are exempt from re-silencing while inherited verbatim; marks recomputed from each new champion's table
settings.classes_rule: step 1 arms: be._base_classes(layout, 0) (prune-graft continuation classes) with freeze marks. Step 2 widened arm: the transplant's own classes from be.make_transplant; step 2 control: _base_classes with the same marks

donor_capture.arm: widen test arm A (plain widen), re-run with its recorded seeds to capture species bests (the widen test saved only its champions)

subject.table_source: widen_test_2026-11-23.json arms.A_plain_widen.density_units (measured on this identical genome in the widen test)

step1_prep.measurement_note: under the freeze rule only the non-exempt units were re-silenced, on this identical genome; exempt units' drops are carried from the widen test's table (same genome, same fixed validation set)

final_champion.stage: step 2 treatment (prune-graft, then plain widen, on the widened champion)
